name: @argo/desktop
description: Argo cockpit on Electron. Scaffold under migration; packaged tests are its gate.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.fake-drivers.json
scripts.build:fake-drivers: bun build src/core/projects/fake-driver/prove-project-contract.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --external=playwright-core --external=chromium-bidi --outfile=scripts/project-fake-driver/prove-project-contract.mjs && bun build src/core/projects/fake-driver/capture-cockpit.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --external=playwright-core --external=chromium-bidi --outfile=scripts/project-fake-driver/capture-cockpit.mjs && bun build src/core/projects/fake-driver/measure-cockpit.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --external=playwright-core --external=chromium-bidi --outfile=scripts/project-fake-driver/measure-cockpit.mjs && bun build src/agents/codex/session-fake-driver/fixtures/fake-codex-app-server.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=scripts/session-fake-driver/fake-codex-app-server.mjs && bun build src/core/sessions/fake-driver/prove-session-feed.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --external=playwright-core --external=chromium-bidi --outfile=scripts/session-fake-driver/prove-session-feed.mjs && bun build src/core/tickets/fake-driver/prove-tickets.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --external=playwright-core --external=chromium-bidi --outfile=scripts/ticket-fake-driver/prove-tickets.mjs
scripts.test:darwin-manifest: electron-forge package --platform darwin --arch arm64 && node scripts/desktop-manifest.mjs out/Argo-darwin-arm64/Argo.app
scripts.test:feed: bun test src/core/sessions src/agents/claude/sessions src/agents/claude/session-fake-driver src/agents/codex/sessions src/renderer/modules/sessions/feed
